t: You're in Charterhouse Square, a pentagonal garden square in Farringdon, close to the former Smithfield Meat Market. It's the largest courtyard of the London Charterhouse, and its buildings are mostly Tudor and Stuart, restored after the Blitz. Around you are a chapel, a Tudor great hall, a medical school and a forty-resident almshouse. Matthew Urlwin Sears, a wood engraver active in London, Leipzig and Paris, lived here. He was born around 1800 and died in 1870.
